transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because my mind just... it won't stay on one thing anymore. I work as a jeweler, and lately at the bench, I just keep jumping around. Like, I'll look at a customer email, then notice a saw mark on a piece... then hear some noise outside. And then I realize I've completely lost the whole work order. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Have you always struggled to keep your focus this way, or is this something that has only started recently?
No, it's... it's just recent. I guess it started right after I won this award at a jewelry show. That whole... wired, kind of out-of-control feeling. It lasted for about two weeks.
During those two weeks when you felt wired and out of control, did you also feel unusually happy, euphoric, or irritable?

Yeah... I guess so. After the show, I just felt... I don't know, lit up, I guess. Like I was larger than life for a minute. But... if people told me to stick to normal shop hours, or tried to get me to slow down... I'd just snap at them. I just didn't want to hear it.
Looking back at your life, have you ever experienced periods where you felt persistently sad, hopeless, or lost interest in your work for weeks at a time?

Yeah... I mean, lately, I guess. These past couple weeks, it's just been... heavy. Like I wake up and there's just this hollow feeling. Everything just feels kind of dull, like the shine is gone. I don't know. I even... I just sat in my truck and cried a bit before opening the shop the other day. So... yeah.
During these recent periods where you felt so heavy and sad, did you ever feel like you were losing touch with reality, such as hearing voices or having thoughts that others found hard to believe?
No. I mean... no, nothing like that. Just... just the sadness.

During that period after the jewelry show when you felt 'wired' and larger than life, did you ever feel like you were having thoughts that were unusual, or did you see or hear things that weren't actually there?
No. Uh... no, nothing like that. I was just... you know, working fast. I didn't see anything that wasn't there.
During these recent weeks when you've been feeling so heavy and sad, have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living?

I... yeah. I guess. 

Um... I just keep having these thoughts that... that my family, and my clients... maybe they'd just be better off if I wasn't around. I'm not going to do anything. I don't have a plan or whatever. It just... it scares me a little. How often it comes up in my head.
During these recent weeks when you've been feeling so heavy and sad, have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns or your appetite?

Yeah, I guess sleep's been... bad. 

Even if I go to bed at a normal time, I just... I toss around. And then I wake up way before dawn. I just lay there thinking about... things. Like this missed delivery I had. And when I finally drag myself up, I don't feel rested at all. 

Appetite's... fine, I guess. I don't know.
Have you found it difficult to perform your daily tasks, such as working at your jewelry bench or taking care of your basic needs, during these past few weeks of feeling so low?

Yeah, I guess. It's... it's been hard to keep up. 

I actually... I missed a major custom delivery. And the records in my shop, they just... they got really disorganized. I had to tell people I can't take new work right now. 

And... my family's been coming around more. I guess they noticed I wasn't... doing my usual stuff. They got worried, so they keep checking on me. But yeah, it's been hard to get things done.
During these past few weeks when you have been feeling this way, have you been able to function at all, or have you been completely unable to carry out your work or daily responsibilities?

I mean... I'm not completely unable to do anything. I can still get out of bed eventually and... eat, I guess. But work is just... I told you, I'm not taking new orders right now. I just can't focus on it.
During these past few weeks when you've been feeling so low, have you noticed that your movements or your speech have slowed down to the point where others might have commented on it?
No... not really. I don't think so. My family hasn't said anything about how I talk or move... I just don't have a lot of energy, that's all.
Over these past few weeks when you've been feeling low, have you lost interest or pleasure in almost all of the activities you usually enjoy, including things outside of your jewelry work?
I don't... no, not really. I still do some things. Just... regular stuff, I guess. I haven't really thought about it.
During these past few weeks, have you felt so tired or drained of energy that you feel like you have almost no energy to do anything at all?

Yeah, I guess. I just... I'm really tired. When I try to sit at my bench, my arms just feel heavy... like lead, I guess. And if I try to polish a setting or... or just move a tray of stones, it just takes everything out of me. Even if I sleep, I still wake up feeling just as wiped out. It's just... hard to do much.
Even if you are still doing some regular things, have you found that you no longer get any real enjoyment or pleasure out of the hobbies or activities you used to love?
I don't know... I guess I still like things okay. It's just... I'm tired, like I said. I haven't really noticed not liking things.

When you do engage in those regular activities you mentioned, do you find that you are still able to experience a sense of joy or pleasure from them, or does it feel more like you are just going through the motions?
I mean... I guess I just do them. It's not like I'm jumping for joy, but... I don't know. I just do what I need to do. I haven't really paid attention to how it feels.

When you are going through these low periods, do you feel that your ability to function is severely hampered to the point where you are struggling to maintain basic self-care, like showering or eating regularly?

I mean... yeah, it's been pretty bad lately. I haven't really been keeping up with things. I... I missed a major custom delivery for a client. And the records in the shop are just a mess right now. I actually had to stop taking on any new work because I can't keep track of it all. And... well, my family's been coming by more. I guess they noticed I wasn't really doing my usual stuff and got worried.
Are you currently able to maintain your personal hygiene, such as showering and dressing yourself, without needing someone else to prompt or assist you?
I mean... I guess I'm managing that part okay. Nobody has to tell me to shower or anything. I just... I might not do it as often, but I can still do it myself.

When you say you have been struggling to keep up with your work and your shop records, would you say that this has caused you a great deal of personal distress, or is it more that you are just finding it difficult to manage the logistics of your business?
I don't really know... I haven't thought about it like that. It's just... I'm just behind on everything right now. I guess I'm just not managing it. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Because of these feelings, have you had to stop doing almost all of your daily responsibilities, or are you still able to manage at least some of your routine tasks?

I mean... I think I already mentioned some of this. I just... I had to stop taking on new work. The shop records are a mess. I missed that custom delivery... so yeah, I guess I've stopped doing a lot of it. And my family is checking in more because... well, because I'm not doing my usual stuff. So... I don't know. I guess I'm just not managing most of it right now.

When you say you have had to stop taking on new work and your shop records are a mess, would you say that you are currently unable to function in most areas of your life, or are you still able to manage most of your daily responsibilities?

I mean... I feel like I just said this. I'm really not managing most of it. Missing that major custom delivery was bad... and the shop records are just too disorganized to take on anything new right now. That's why my family keeps checking up on me. They got worried because they can see how far I've slipped from my normal routine. So... yeah. I'm not really functioning in most areas.

patient.answer: I mean... I feel like I just said this. I'm really not managing most of it. Missing that major custom delivery was bad... and the shop records are just too disorganized to take on anything new right now. That's why my family keeps checking up on me. They got worried because they can see how far I've slipped from my normal routine. So... yeah. I'm not really functioning in most areas.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a clear history of a manic-like episode (two weeks of being 'wired', euphoric, and irritable) followed by a current major depressive episode. The severity of the depressive symptoms, including significant functional impairment (inability to maintain work responsibilities, missed deadlines) and suicidal ideation, supports a diagnosis of bipolar disorder, current episode depressed, severe without psychotic features.

confirmed_symptoms: significant functional impairment in occupational domain

diagnostic_checklist.duration_verified: Manic symptoms lasted two weeks; depressive symptoms are currently ongoing.
